name: tiktok-watcher
description: Summarize a TikTok video from its URL — Claude downloads it, watches the frames, transcribes the audio, and writes a structured summary.

metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin that downloads, watches, and summarizes TikTok videos locally.

plugins.name: tiktok-watcher
plugins.description: Takes a TikTok video or photo URL, downloads it with yt-dlp, extracts keyframes and audio with ffmpeg, transcribes speech with local Whisper, and produces a structured summary plus a saved artifact bundle.
